payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear list of datasets used for document classification tasks, detailing their sources and characteristics.

claims.text: The datasets used include Reuters, BBCSport, Polarity, Subjectivity, and MPQA.
The Reuters dataset consists of stories from the Reuters news agency collected in 1987.
The BBCSport dataset contains sports news articles from the BBC Sport website from 2004-2005.
The Polarity dataset features positive and negative labeled snippets from Rotten Tomatoes.
The Subjectivity dataset includes movie review snippets and plot summaries from Rotten Tomatoes and IMDb.
The MPQA dataset consists of positive and negative phrases annotated for multi-perspective question answering.
